notes.title: Announcing Amazing Trivia, Coming January 2018
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today, we're announcing an all-new trivia game called Amazing Trivia.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/771320/Amazing_Trivia/

Amazing Trivia is a classic trivia game where questions are split into multiple categories. We made sure that all of your favorite features from our past games are present; there are interesting questions, missions, explanations and achievements. We’ll do our best to use all the feedback that you’ve provided for our other games!

Amazing Trivia will be released on Steam in the late January 2018, and it’s price on the release will be less than $0.99. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and follow it on Steam to receive updates.

And that's it for today. We're going to kickstart 2018 with two new great games - Amazing Trivia and Foxus, and I can’t wait to share them with you. I’m sure that 2018 is going to be an incredible year for all of us!

Thanks for reading, and until the next time!

notes.title: True or False Universe launches September 15th
notes.content:
About a year ago we've announced the new game which changed our lives. Some of you might still remember it. It was called True or False. If you were with us since the day one, you remember that on launch True or False was a free game with optional DLC. Your feeback helped us to improve the game and make True or False 2 which had over 95% positive reviews on Steam for several months after its release.

Today we're happy to announce [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370/True_or_False_Universe/]True or False Universe[/url], all-new free-to-play game in the series.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098736/6455ab93e037e97ee67e4be63adbe09a62f803ef.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370?beta=0

The best thing about True or False games is that you can learning something new by playing it while having fun. True or False Universe takes the concept further - now you will learn something new everyday.

We consulted several top experts in the field of free-to-play games, and they have contributed their ideas about how to improve player's experience. This means that the game will provide modern up-to-date free-to-play experience. 

We built True or False Universe to scale. That means that we want to support it with regular content updates after its release for some time.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370/True_or_False_Universe/]True or False Universe[/url] will be available on September 15th. You can add it to your wishlist now and follow it to receive future updates.

We just love to build games, and we're happy to see you having fun. Let is know what you think!

notes.title: True or False 2 is out now!
First Look: Achievements
notes.content:
Now it's time to lift the fog on the the achievements!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499743/86b676d493eb3fde0277228bba4fdaf61b6dd7f7.png[/img]

This time, achievements were based on players suggestions. Thank you everyone who shared their opinions on the subject!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499743/108f0db99916c47dedd8d3978851b83e3db4491a.png[/img]

Firstly, True or False 2 has the complete minimalistic English alphabet, 
so you could can make stylish achievement showcase with your nickname. Yikes!

Next, it will feature basic Hiragana characters for achievements as well!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499743/acac31f4c57f3f4f5c1605da08aea8d9cb0c3e0f.png[/img]

That's not all! We're working on bringing user localization support, so players could translate the game into their native languages. You're welcome to translate the game into your native language, but we're unable to manage fan-based translations this time.

The game will feature Japanese translation made by our brave samurai Chelni, so anyone could see an example on how to translate the game into their own language.

See you soon!
